sources_inspected.use: External and internal instability, partial and improper constraints, independence of equilibrium equations, component count

Global external-force signs, cut-face signs, compression-side plotting, downward-positive w, triangular-load benchmark

meaning_and_evidence_review.result: Completed after correcting notation, directions, dimensions, and source-specific differences

Distributed-load editor and drawing labels display downward-positive w; stored upward-positive force components and old model files retain their meaning
Method-of-sections formulas use V'=-w and M'=V; Lean certificates check w=-q
Double integration displays C1,C2,... in EI*theta and EI*v, with kN m^2 and kN m^3 units and exact certificate checks
Virtual work uses a downward 1 kN virtual force; normalised m has length units, integral contributions have displacement units, and Delta=-v is checked
Reaction symbols use labelled points consistently; unlabelled interior supports use indexed R components
Tangent deviation is distinguished from absolute displacement, and the moment-area target coordinate is x_s
Definitions distinguish ground supports, rigid joints, internal hinges, semi-rigid springs, and member-specific constraints
Stability and static indeterminacy include the course count definitions, geometry caveat, small-motion scope, and engaged-contact assumption

voice_and_implication_review.result: Completed after the technical corrections; explanations use course method names, define symbols beside the equations, and state direction changes explicitly
